summary: Strive, Inc. filed an 8-K on May 14, 2026, reporting its Q1 2026 financial results under Item 2.02 and announcing business updates under Item 8.01. The updates include a change in dividend payment frequency on its Variable Rate Series A Perpetual Preferred Stock from monthly to daily, effective June 16, 2026, via an amended certificate of designation, and a digital asset purchase of 1,381 bitcoin. No merger, acquisition, tender offer, spin-off, restructuring, delisting, or other special-situation event is described. The filing is a routine operational and financial update, not a special situation.
